title: StakeSpeaks
tagline: Stake-to-learn platform where expert discussions generate financial rewards"
description:
StakeSpeaks is a revolutionary decentralized discussion platform that transforms how expert knowledge is monetized and consumed online. By combining financial commitment through staking with real-time payments and yield generation, we create the world's first "stake-to-learn" economy where education becomes financially rewarding for all participants.
🔥 The Problem We Solve
Traditional online knowledge platforms face critical challenges:

Experts struggle to monetize their expertise beyond basic subscriptions or courses
Low-quality discussions dominate free platforms due to lack of commitment
Passive learning with no financial incentive for deep engagement
Centralized platforms extract most value while creators get minimal revenue
No transparency in how content is moderated or monetized

💡 Our Solution
StakeSpeaks introduces a multi-layered economic model that aligns incentives across all participants:
For Speakers (Experts):

Set custom KDA staking requirements to filter serious audiences
Receive 80% of all PYUSD superchats instantly during discussions
Build reputation that increases earning potential over time
Access growing audience pools with compound yield incentives

For Listeners (Learners):

Stake KDA tokens to join premium discussions, ensuring committed participation
Earn yield on staked tokens through DeFi integration during sessions
Receive proportional share of 20% superchat pool distributed among participants
Benefit from compound yield growth through our innovative retention mechanism

For the Ecosystem:

All session data permanently stored on Filecoin for transparency and verification
Creates valuable conversational datasets for AI training and research
Self-sustaining economic model with multiple revenue streams
Mainstream adoption through seamless PYUSD/PayPal integration
how_its_made:
StakeSpeaks is a decentralized discussion platform that revolutionizes how expert knowledge is monetized and consumed online. Users stake KDA tokens to join premium discussions with verified experts, while real-time PYUSD superchats create instant revenue streams for speakers. Our innovative compound yield mechanism ensures listeners earn returns on their stakes, creating a sustainable economy where learning is financially rewarded. All session data is permanently stored on Filecoin, ensuring transparency and creating valuable conversational datasets for AI training.

## 🏗️ **Technical Architecture & Sponsor Integration**

We built StakeSpeaks as a **multi-chain application** leveraging the unique strengths of each sponsor ecosystem. Our **smart contracts are deployed on Kadena's Chainweb EVM** using **Solidity**, taking advantage of Kadena's ultra-low transaction costs ($0.007 average) and infinite scalability through their unique Proof-of-Work architecture. This enables cost-effective micro-staking and high-throughput session management that would be prohibitively expensive on traditional blockchains.

For payments, we integrated **PYUSD as our primary stablecoin rail**, enabling seamless superchats where mainstream PayPal users can tip speakers in real-time without complex crypto onboarding. The 80/20 split mechanism (80% to speakers, 20% to listener reward pools) creates sustainable monetization while rewarding engaged audiences. Our **frontend is built with Next.js and deployed on Vercel**, providing a seamless Web2-like experience that abstracts blockchain complexity from end users.

**Filecoin integration** powers our session archival system, storing complete audio recordings, chat logs, and metadata using the **Synapse SDK**. This creates immutable proof of discussions while building valuable conversational datasets that can be monetized for AI training, establishing multiple revenue streams beyond live sessions.

The **compound yield mechanism** is our key innovation - when users stake KDA tokens, they're deployed to Kadena DeFi protocols generating returns. Only 30% of yield is distributed immediately, with 70% compounding in the pool, creating exponentially growing rewards that incentivize long-term platform engagement and speaker loyalty.
